identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16] Register three-platform distributed native proof workflow

values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove exact checkout, three-platform production, distinct artifacts, live hosted attestation, aggregate validation, pinned actions, bounded timeouts, fail-closed behavior, and repository path-policy compatibility.
lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned workflow and focused validator are created only after typed binding.

lanes.proof_role: Reject whitespace errors and unintended tracked churn.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on invalid or mutable checkout input, missing matrix coverage, artifact collision, missing receipt fragments, aggregation failure, action pin drift, widened permissions, out-of-scope paths, failed validation, review drift, or hosted CI failure.
